---
title: "Asynchronous sessions"
---

This site hosts the asynchronous sessions for DVN36104.

Work through the parts of each session in order.

Every code cell runs Python in your browser. Edit the code and press **Run Code**.

Where a page has an exercise, attempt it before using the hints. Check the solution only after making your own attempt.

Your work here is **not saved** when you close the tab.

## Session 1

- [Part A · Allometry](session1/part-a.qmd)
- [Part B · The Tree of Life](session1/part-b.qmd)
- [Part C · The Triangle of Everything](session1/part-c.qmd)
- [Part D · The Periodic Spiral](session1/part-d.qmd)
- [Part E · Codons](session1/part-e.qmd)

Submit through [Canvas](https://canvas.uts.edu.au/courses/41964/assignments/293267):

- **Part A**: the final chart of your amniote investigation, with panels
  at different levels of aggregation.
- **Part B**: your tree-of-life figure. The download cell at the end of
  the page saves it as a PNG.
- **Part C**: your Triangle of Everything chart.
- **Part D**: the alternative periodic-table design you found, different
  from the six shown on the page. Not the table you built.
- **Part E**: your codon chart.

Session 1 is complete. Sessions 2 and 3 will appear here when they are released.
